title: Tenant safety net: tripline per-entity thresholds and transparent-delegate policy
creator: Ava Martinez
description: We need a new per-entity degradation primitive ("tripline") that combines dependency-level, model-variant, and tenant-budget thresholds into a transparent delegate policy. The goal is to fail fast and safely when a dependency or model variant is stressed while preserving the best available user experience (cached responses, smaller model variants, or a lightweight graceful degrade path). This ticket covers the design, router + runtime implementation, rollout, and monitoring for tripline evaluation and delegate routing.
background_and_motivation: We currently rely on coarse global breakers and a handful of per-route heuristics. Incidents show noisy cross-tenant impact when a single heavy tenant or a downstream dependency spikes. Tripline formalizes: (1) per-entity thresholds (tenant, model, dependency), (2) a smoothing/hysteresis window to avoid flapping, and (3) an ordered, auditable set of delegate fallbacks that are transparent to tenants (logged and surfaced in console). This reduces blast radius and enables predictable SLO preservation across regions.
acceptance_criteria: Configurable tripline rules that can express tenant/model/dependency thresholds and priorities (JSON schema)
Router evaluates tripline in real time with <=2ms median decision overhead and respects hysteresis windows
Delegate chain supports: cached response, small-quantized model, lower-burst quota, and final degraded placeholder
Observability: per-trip metrics (rate, cohorts, chosen delegate), per-tenant auditing in Console, and alerting on unusual delegate rates
Automated chaos test that injects dependency latency and triggers expected delegate behavior for 90%+ of test runs
implementation_notes: Introduce 'tripline' config stored in service-configs (supporting overrides: org-default, tenant-override, route-override)
Decision logic lives in the request router layer (pre-dispatch) to minimize wasted GPU cycles; runtime receives only forwarded decision + delegate hint
Hysteresis: exponential backoff window with decay parameter per-entity to avoid thrash; implement sliding window bloom counters for efficiency
Delegate types: CACHE (prefix+KV), MODEL_LIGHT (smaller quantized variant), QUOTA_SHELVED (rate-limited path), DEGRADE_PLACEHOLDER (structured apology/partial response)
tasks: Design schema and validation for tripline config (PM + Eng)
Router: implement tripline evaluation and delegate hint propagation (Eng)
Runtime: accept delegate hint and fast-path for lightweight delegates (Eng)
Console: surface trip events with links to tenant logs and chosen delegate (DX)
Create chaos suite and ramp plan (SRE)
Docs: runbook snippets and config examples (DevRel)
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: misconfigured tenant overrides could over-degrade. Mitigation: safe defaults and dry-run mode that logs decisions without enforcing.
Risk: added latency in router. Mitigation: microbench router path and cap decision time with cached evaluation results for hot tenants.
Risk: audit volume. Mitigation: sample trip events and provide aggregated cohort metrics plus per-tenant sampling toggle.
notes_and_discussions: 2026-02-22: Sync w/PM and SRE — agreed to prioritize tenant-budget threshold and model-variant fallbacks initially. Jordan to prototype router decision tree.
2026-03-01: Prototype found decision cost ~1.9ms median on staging for 95th%-heavy routes. Need to optimize for 99th percentile.
2026-03-05: Design review: add 'transparent delegate' requirement — must include reason code and a reference id surfaced in trace for customer debug.
2026-03-10: SRE proposed an automated rollback hook that lifts tenant overrides if delegate rate exceeds 40% sustained for 10m. Pending implementation details.
